description: This file provides helper functions for encoding and decoding Base64 operations, including functions for encoding binary data to Base64 strings and decoding Base64 strings back into binary data. It contains conditional compilation to support different underlying libraries (beecrypt or mbedtls) based on build configuration.

methods.name: char * icEncodeBase64(uint8_t * array,uint16_t arrayLen)
methods.description: Encodes a binary array into a Base64 string. Returns the encoded string or NULL if input is invalid.

methods.name: bool icDecodeBase64(const char * srcStr,uint8_t ** array,uint16_t * arrayLen)
methods.description: Decodes a Base64 encoded string into a binary array. Returns true if successful, false otherwise. Allocates memory for the output array which must be freed by the caller.
